_readme: Skills, tags, status effects and skill trees. Percentages are fractions (0.8 = 80%). Ranges are in tiles (Euclidean: 1 = the 4 neighbours, 1.5 includes diagonals). Cooldown N = can't be used during your next N turns. Keys starting with _ are comments. The game checks this file on load and reports the exact field if something is wrong.

_fields.target: unit (aim at a tile, affects the unit there) | self | line (8 directions) | cone (overwatch) | emptyTile
_fields.hits: list of hits, each { pAtk, mAtk, def, missingHp } as fractions
_fields.los: sight (rocks block) | fire (rocks AND units block). Omit for none.
_fields.rangeScale: for 'movement' skills: range = floor(rangeScale x Movement)
_fields.optional: heal { mAtk }, shield { maxHpPct, turns }, knockback (tiles), cleanse, teleport, charge, aoeRadius, lineLength, cone { angle, radius, interrupt, los }, accuracy

melee.name: Melee
melee.description: Close-range attack. No line of sight needed.

engage.name: Engage
engage.description: On hit, you and the target become engaged (unless the target is already engaged). Engaged units have half Defense, can't move, and can only attack each other until one disengages, which gives the other a free basic attack.

projectile.name: Projectile
projectile.description: Needs a clear line to the target: line of sight (rocks block) or line of fire (rocks and units block).

indirect.name: Indirect
indirect.description: Arcs over obstacles. No line of sight needed.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.description: Pushes targets away. Walls and other units stop the push.

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.description: Sets a watch that triggers during the enemy's turn when they move into it. Lasts until your next turn.

movement.name: Movement
movement.description: Range scales with your Movement (rounded down), so Slow shortens it.

weapon.name: Weapon
weapon.description: Uses your weapon's basic-attack range and line rules. Unusable while your weapon is disabled.

free.name: Free Action
free.description: Doesn't use your action. You can still act afterwards.

debuff.name: Debuff
debuff.description: Applies a harmful effect that Cleanse can remove.

burn.name: Burn
burn.description: Lose 1% of max Health per stack at the start of each turn. Ignores Defense and shields.

slash_and_smash.name: Slash and Smash
slash_and_smash.description: Slash an enemy for 80% P.Atk, then bash it with your shield for 40% P.Atk + 100% Def.

shield_up.name: Shield Up
shield_up.description: Gain a shield equal to 10% of your max Health until your next turn.

spear_thrust.name: Spear Thrust
spear_thrust.description: Thrust in a direction, hitting the first enemy within 2 tiles for 100% P.Atk and knocking it back 1 tile.

circle_swing.name: Circle Swing
circle_swing.description: Sweep all 8 surrounding tiles, hitting every unit (allies included) for 100% P.Atk and knocking them back 1 tile.

intercept.name: Intercept
intercept.description: Guard a 60° cone up to 2 tiles away. The first enemy to move into it takes 100% P.Atk and is stopped.

direct_shot.name: Direct Shot
direct_shot.description: Shoot an enemy for 100% P.Atk. Blocked by rocks and by units in the way.

indirect_shot.name: Indirect Shot
indirect_shot.description: Lob an arrow at an enemy for 70% P.Atk. Arcs over obstacles.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Watch a 60° cone up to 5 tiles away. The first enemy to move into it is shot for 100% P.Atk but keeps moving.

empowered_strike.name: Empowered Strike
empowered_strike.description: Strike an enemy for 100% P.Atk + 50% M.Atk.

magic_bolt.name: Magic Bolt
magic_bolt.description: Fire a bolt at an enemy for 50% P.Atk + 50% M.Atk.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.description: Fire an arcane bolt at an enemy for 100% M.Atk.

arcane_pulse.name: Arcane Pulse
arcane_pulse.description: Blast an enemy for 100% M.Atk and knock it back 2 tiles.

arcane_shift.name: Arcane Shift
arcane_shift.description: Teleport to an empty tile within 50% of your Movement.

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Hurl a fireball at an enemy for 100% M.Atk and apply 1 stack of Burn for 2 turns.

freeze.name: Freeze
freeze.description: Freeze an enemy for 100% M.Atk and apply Slow for 2 turns.

heal.name: Heal
heal.description: Heal an ally or yourself for 80% M.Atk.

cleanse.name: Cleanse
cleanse.description: Remove all debuffs from an ally or yourself.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Dash next to an enemy within 100% of your Movement and strike it for 80% P.Atk.

kick.name: Kick
kick.description: Kick an adjacent enemy for 60% P.Atk.

execute.name: Execute
execute.description: Strike an enemy for 50% P.Atk + 10% of its missing Health, at your weapon's range.
